# asym (Asymmetric.al)

> Open-source giving, donor care, and operations on one shared foundation for nonprofits, with practical AI in development.

Built by Asymmetric.al, an independent, for-profit software company serving nonprofits of any size. Founded by Conrad O'Brien (who co-leads Global Fellowship, a missions organization) and Blake. Named for asymmetric leverage: multiplying what an organization can accomplish without multiplying administrative drag. We are starting with missions organizations because we know that work firsthand, with the goal of modern software any nonprofit can rely on.

## Vision
- Less overhead, outsized impact: bring giving, donor care, and operations onto one open-source foundation so nonprofits of any size spend more time with the people they serve.
- Practical AI, built into the core (in development): AI built onto the shared giving core to draft campaigns from real fund and donor context, lighten routine donor care, and clear repetitive admin, with teams editing before anything goes out.

## Status
- Public codebase: https://github.com/Asymmetric-al/core (AGPL-3.0-only, 5,200+ commits on develop, 600+ repository-wide merged PRs since January 2026, verified November 2026).
- In public code: authenticated donor portal with giving history, recurring-gift review (opening Stripe payment settings when needed), individual receipts, and settled-only annual statements (`apps/donor`, `packages/api/src/donor-portal`); assignment-scoped missionary supporter roster defaulting to `Anonymous partner` with `total_given` and `last_gift_amount` withheld on roster rows while aggregate analytics stay separate (`apps/missionary`, `packages/api/src/missionary-portal`); Mission Control CRM, Payload Web Studio website/template tools, and supported batch previews (`apps/admin`, `packages/api/src/admin/contribution-batches`).
- Partial: public worker directory and checkout recipient lookup in `apps/donor` still render `@asym/mock-data` sample profiles; offline gift entry orchestration (`packages/api/src/admin/contributions/offline-entry.ts`) is in code with DB persistence intentionally switched off (`501`) pending migration, and accepted design notes (`docs/adr` 0004, 0010, and 0012) specify thank-you, offline-entry, and recurring-gift rules.
- In development (not open yet): AI campaign drafting and donor-care assistance, hosted team subscription and onboarding (pricing unpublished), and optional future managed donor care.
